finding.summary: The dashboard adapter copied the complete producer-authored provenance mapping into an owner-visible event. Unknown nested/raw fields could therefore cross the adapter despite not being required for provenance display.

bounded_repair: Dashboard provenance is now reference-only through an explicit allowlist.
Unknown producer-authored provenance fields are omitted instead of echoed.
Allowed provenance fields must be scalar strings; nested structures fail closed.
source_fingerprint must be a non-empty string.
Owner-visible summary length is bounded; exact presentation bound remains TEST_REQUIRED.
authority_from_drive remains 0, external_action_set remains empty, action_buttons remain empty, and canonical_personality_mutation remains false.
authored_adversarial_tests: unknown raw provenance fields are not echoed
nested value in an allowed provenance reference is rejected
test_required: whether quarantine_reason and prediction_outcome require separate structured minimization schemas
whether owner-visible entity_id/trust_status require enum/reference validation
quantum_independent_review_requests: Check whether omission of unknown provenance keys is preferable to quarantine for malformed producer records.
Review quarantine_reason and prediction_outcome for equivalent arbitrary nested data passthrough.
Check that dashboard minimization cannot hide evidence required for provenance/audit reconstruction; canonical audit data must remain in the ledger, not the dashboard projection.
Confirm no dashboard field can become an authority or Experience/personality-learning input.
